#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
#define infinity 1e9+9
#define pii pair<int,int>
#define ppi pair<pii,int>
#define ll long long
#define MAXN 1001
#define MAXM 1001
#define MAXSINK 1001

struct Edge
{
int u,v,flow,capacity;
Edge(int u,int v,int flow,int capacity)
{
this->u=u;
this->v=v;
this->flow=flow;
this->capacity=capacity;
}
};

int source,sink;
vector<vector<int> > G;
vector<Edge> e;

void addEdge(int u,int v,int capacity)
{
G[u].push_back(e.size());
e.push_back(Edge(u,v,0,capacity));
G[v].push_back(e.size());
e.push_back(Edge(v,u,0,0));
}

int ptr[MAXN];
int dist[MAXN];

bool findPath()
{
memset(dist,-1,sizeof dist);
dist[source]=0;
queue<int> Q;
Q.push(source);
while(!Q.empty())
{

    int u=Q.front();
    Q.pop();
    
    for(int i=0;i<G[u].size();++i)
    {
    int id=G[u][i];
    int v=e[id].v;
    
    if(dist[v]==-1 && e[id].flow<e[id].capacity)
        {
        dist[v]=dist[u]+1;
        Q.push(v);
        if(v==sink)
        return true;
        }
    }

}
return false;
}

ll sendFlow(int u,int flow)
{
if(flow==0)
return 0;

if(u==sink)
return flow;

for(;ptr[u]<G[u].size();++ptr[u])
{
int id=G[u][ptr[u]];
int v=e[id].v;
if(dist[v]!=dist[u]+1)
    continue;
ll pushed=sendFlow(v,min(flow,e[id].capacity-e[id].flow));
if(pushed)
{
    e[id].flow+=pushed;
    e[id^1].flow-=pushed;
    return pushed;  
}
}

return 0;

}

ll dinics()
{
ll flow=0;
while(findPath())
{   
    memset(ptr,0,sizeof ptr);
    while(int pushed=sendFlow(source,infinity))
        flow+=pushed;
}
return flow;
}

string scientists[MAXM];
string reactors[MAXM];
bool isReachable[10][10][10][10];
int visited[MAXM][MAXM];
int becomesUnusableAt[10][10];
int n,m;
bool isValid(int r,int c)
{
if(r>=0 && c>=0 && r<n && c<m)
return true;
return false;
}

int getID(int x,int y)
{
return 1+m*x+y;
}

{
  ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
  int T;
  cin>>n>>T;
++T;
  m=n;
    sink=m*m + m*m + 1;
    source=0;
    G.resize(m*m*2 + 2);
  queue<pii> Q;
  for(int i=0;i<n;++i)
    cin>>scientists[i];
  
  for(int i=0;i<n;++i)
    {
    cin>>reactors[i];
    for(int j=0;j<m;++j)
      {
    becomesUnusableAt[i][j]=infinity;
        if(reactors[i][j]=='Z')
          {
          Q.push(pii(i,j));
          becomesUnusableAt[i][j]=1;
          }
      } 
    }
  
while(!Q.empty())
{
int x=Q.front().first;
int y=Q.front().second;
Q.pop();


for(int i=-1;i<=1;++i)

for(int j=-1;j<=1;++j)
{

if(abs(i)+abs(j)==1)
{
int nx=x+i;
int ny=y+j;
if(isValid(nx,ny) && becomesUnusableAt[nx][ny]==infinity && scientists[nx][ny]!='Y')  
{
becomesUnusableAt[nx][ny]=becomesUnusableAt[x][y]+1;
Q.push(pii(nx,ny));
}   
}

}

}
  


  /* build graph */
  for(int x=0;x<n;++x)
  {
    for(int y=0;y<m;++y)
    {
    if(scientists[x][y]>='1' && scientists[x][y]<='9')
    addEdge(source,getID(x,y),scientists[x][y]-'0');
    
    if(reactors[x][y]>='1' && reactors[x][y]<='9')
        addEdge(n*n+getID(x,y),sink,reactors[x][y]-'0');
      for(int X=0;X<n;++X)
      {
        for(int Y=0;Y<m;++Y)
        {
          if(scientists[x][y]=='Y' || scientists[x][y]=='Z' || reactors[X][Y]=='Y' || reactors[X][Y]=='Z')
            continue;
          
          memset(visited,false,sizeof visited);
          queue<ppi> Q;
          Q.push(ppi(pii(x,y),1));
          visited[x][y]=true;
          while(!Q.empty())
            {
              int x=Q.front().first.first;
              int y=Q.front().first.second;
              int tim=Q.front().second;
              Q.pop();
              
        if(x==X && y==Y)
        {
            visited[x][y]=true;
            break;
        }  
        
        if(tim>=becomesUnusableAt[x][y] || tim>=T)
            continue;
              for(int i=-1;i<=1;++i)
              {
                for(int j=-1;j<=1;++j)
                  {
                    if(abs(i)+abs(j)==1)
                    {
                      int nx=x+i,ny=y+j;

                      if(isValid(nx,ny) && !visited[nx][ny] && (scientists[nx][ny]!='Y') && (scientists[nx][ny]!='Z') && tim+1<=becomesUnusableAt[nx][ny])
            {
                visited[nx][ny]=true;
                Q.push(ppi(pii(nx,ny),tim+1));
            }
                    }
                  }
              }         
            }
    done:
    if(visited[X][Y])
    {
    addEdge(getID(x,y),n*n+getID(X,Y),infinity);
    }

    }
      }
    }
  }     
    
    int ans=dinics();
    
cout<<ans<<endl;
    
}
